h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ludhiana

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ludhiana

items.pText: Ludhiana is Punjab's industrial centre, known for hosiery, bicycles and machine parts, and its buyers tend to look closely at how a product is built. FunPlay Systems welcomes that. Our outdoor playground equipment is designed, roto-moulded and fabricated in-house at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai. We send it about 1,320 km by road to Ludhiana.

Enquiries from the city come from private schools, gated colonies, farmhouse owners and clubs, along with the parks and gardens maintained by the municipal corporation. Our installation team or a dealer in north India sets the equipment up on site. We have been making play equipment since 2002. Every project starts with a layout drawing that marks the safe play area.

props.h3Text: Top Factors Which Make Us the Best Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer in Ludhiana, Punjab?

items.pText: Being in this field from long, we know the value of raw materials for creating Outdoor Playground Equipment. For this reason, our designers make use of high-quality raw materials for manufacturing Outdoor Playground Equipment in Ludhiana, Punjab. We have tie-ups with some of the most leading manufacturers of Outdoor Playground Equipment. Apart from that, we test the materials in our industry before taking them into use. After keeping them under observation for some days, we check whether they are weatherproof or not.

Every place requires a different type of Outdoor Playground Equipment from another. The Outdoor Playground Equipment manufactured in Ludhiana, Punjab by our company never look alike. They all have different sizes and colors. We give the most refined look to each Outdoor Playground Equipment so that it serves the purpose of the place well. In addition to that, we select the unique colors in making Outdoor Playground Equipment. Our Outdoor Playground Equipment look classy wherever you place it.

items.pText: Whenever you will search in Google for the canopy manufacturer in Ludhiana, Punjab you will always find the name of Shelter enterprises prevailing at the top.

One of the main things which make us a top-notch Outdoor Playground Equipment manufacturer in Ludhiana, Punjab is the after-sales service. Our skilled team of technicians believes in helping the customers even after selling the products. We promise to work again if you are not satisfied with our project for the first time. Our company sends a team of professionals again in case the Outdoor Playground Equipment get damaged due to rainwater or heat.

c: Posts and frames are made from galvanised steel pipe, cut and welded in our own fabrication unit. Slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded from plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Raw materials are tested, and each piece goes through quality inspection before dispatch.

That is why we can give three years of warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

richText.heading: Punjab's hot summers and cold winters

c: Ludhiana swings from very hot, dry summers to cold winters with dense fog. Metal and plastic expand and contract with these changes, so have the joints and fixings checked at the end of each season. Rubber flooring under the equipment stays softer than packed earth, which turns hard in both extremes.
Slides in full sun get hot in May and June. Face them north or east where you can, or add shade over the deck.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Ludhiana?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, send the equipment to Ludhiana by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India. The process starts with your site size, age group and a few photos.

items.q: Is the equipment made in your own factory?
items.a: Yes. Design, roto-moulding and fabrication are all done in-house at our Vasai factory, and every piece is inspected before it is dispatched. You deal directly with the manufacturer, from the first drawing to after sales support.

items.q: Can you make equipment in our school colours?
items.a: We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and can customise designs on request. Tell us your colours and we will suggest the closest match. Colour changes are confirmed on the layout before manufacture begins.

items.q: How is the equipment fixed to the ground?
items.a: We use either the self-standing method or grouting into concrete, depending on your ground. We decide this after seeing the site photos and the type of surface. Grouting is common on open lawns, while self-standing suits paved or podium areas.
